title: A Computable Measure of Suboptimality for Entropy-Regularised Variational Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2509.10393v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Several methods in statistics and machine learning target a probability distribution for which an entropy-regularised variational objective is minimised. This increased flexibility introduces a computational challenge, as one loses access to an explicit unnormalised density for the target. To mitigate this difficulty, we introduce a novel measure of suboptimality called 'gradient discrepancy', and in particular a kernel gradient discrepancy (KGD) that can be explicitly computed. In the Bayesian statistics context, KGD coincides with the kernel Stein discrepancy (KSD), and we obtain a novel characterisation of KSD as measuring the size of a variational gradient. Outside this familiar setting, KGD enables novel sampling algorithms to be developed and compared, even when unnormalised densities cannot be obtained. To illustrate this point several novel algorithms are proposed and studied, including a natural generalisation of Stein

translated_title: 熵正则化变分目标次优性的可计算度量
translated_abstract: 统计学和机器学习中的多种方法都以最小化熵正则化变分目标所得到的概率分布为目标。这种更高的灵活性带来了计算上的挑战，因为此时无法获得目标分布的显式未归一化密度。为缓解这一困难，我们提出了一种称为“梯度差异”的次优性新度量，特别是提出了一种可显式计算的核梯度差异。在贝叶斯统计的背景下，KGD 与核 Stein 差异相吻合，并且我们获得了 KSD 的一种新颖刻画，即它度量的是变分梯度的大小。在这一熟悉场景之外，即使无法获得未归一化密度，KGD 也使得新型采样算法的开发与比较成为可能。为说明这一点，我们提出并研究了若干新颖算法，包括对 Stein 的一种自然推广
tldr: 本文提出可显式计算的核梯度差异（KGD）作为熵正则化变分目标次优性的度量，在贝叶斯情形下与核 Stein 差异（KSD）一致，从而使研究者在无法获得未归一化密度的情况下也能开发和比较新型采样算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a computable kernel gradient discrepancy (KGD) to measure suboptimality of entropy-regularised variational objectives, coinciding with kernel Stein discrepancy in the Bayesian setting and enabling novel sampling algorithms even without access to unnormalised densities.
